en: Added `engines["claude-code"]` to `plugin.json`: plugins outside their stated Claude Code version range are not installed, updated or loaded, and install and update pick the newest version that fits
zh: 在 `plugin.json` 中新增 `engines["claude-code"]`：超出所声明 Claude Code 版本范围的 plugin 不会被安装、更新或加载，安装和更新时会选择符合范围的最新版本
